# Wiki Links

Show incoming and outgoing wiki-link relationships in page details.

![Wiki Links preview](/assets/plugins/wiki-links/preview.png)

- Plugin ID: `me.kumbuka.wiki-links`
- Source version: `1.2.0`
- Permissions: `pages:read`

[Source](https://github.com/kumbuka-me/plugins/tree/main/wiki-links) · [Releases](https://github.com/kumbuka-me/plugins/releases?q=wiki-links%2Fv) · [Installation](../../administration/plugins.md)

Wiki Links adds incoming and outgoing wiki-link relationships to Kumbuka page details.

The plugin owns the page-details widget and its presentation. Kumbuka core continues to parse <code>&#91;&#91;Page&#93;&#93;</code> references, maintain the page-link graph, resolve aliases, and mark broken links in page content independently of the plugin lifecycle.

## Permissions

- `pages:read` reads authorized backlinks and outgoing link metadata for the current page.
